utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — just so you know, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — happy to help. If you hear of anything else needed, I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that sounds great. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center, and we’ll keep the repair drive moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center with the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — I really appreciate you bringing those. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll still bring the tools—does that time work for you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, Sunday at the community center works for me—thanks for bringing the tools. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—how about 9 a.m. at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — thanks for the reminder, Pia. I’m still in for Sunday at the community center; what do you want me to bring or set up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you bring the extension cords and a couple of spare bulbs? I’m a bit worried we’ll run short, so that should cover the setup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll bring the extension cords and a couple of spare bulbs on Sunday. Anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Just keep me posted on the pickup time and headcount so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep asking around and pass along the pickup time, headcount, and any new repair drive updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that’s exactly what I need. Just keep the pickup time and headcount clear so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — just send the list and timing when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll double-check the list and timing, then send them over so you can bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll be ready with the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep track of the remaining supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send you the list as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Jules — I’ll check in after errands and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep things moving here and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll be back after errands with an update on what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, we’re still on for 3 PM today — swing by then and I’ll send the update after I confirm who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just wanted to make sure. See you at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — see you at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — could you start with the donated items and flag anything that looks missing? I really appreciate your help at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll sort through the donated items and keep an eye out for any missing screws or zip ties.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — that’s perfect. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so just let me know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—see you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam—thanks again for bringing the screwdriver set and gloves. See you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess—I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for catching me up; I’ll remember the parking lot sign-up and the tool kits too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — Sunday at the community center, and yes, the parking lot sign-up and tool kits are the key things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center, parking lot sign-up, and tool kits. I’ll keep that straight this time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a lead on the missing items, Eli—just finalizing the list now and I’ll send it over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane. Send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll keep the drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Just about set, Eli—I’m finishing the list now and will send the missing items your way shortly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds right — Sunday at the community center is the main stop now, and the parking lot can be the backup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep telling folks to head to the community center on Sunday, with the parking lot as backup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — that should cover both stops for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update, and then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on it while I’m out and let you know as soon as I have an update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update, then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help with both.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — I really appreciate it. We’ll meet Sunday at the community center and get both tasks started there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad to help, Rosa — I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll grab it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll do a quick inventory and send you the missing items. The drive’s in good shape so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and grab whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll head over right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll have the tools set out and ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I’ll see you right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—the repair drive is still on for 3 PM today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, 3 PM today still works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure—see you at 3 then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center. Thanks, Rey!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces too — do they know what needs fixing yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet, I think they’re still making the list. Once that’s set, they’ll ask around for help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — thanks. If you hear what they land on, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center should be better. I can sort the supplies this afternoon, and a quiet call later today works.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll keep it quiet. What time this afternoon works best for you at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Late afternoon would be best for me. I’ll be there quietly, and we can keep the call brief.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep you posted on what still needs fixing, and I’ll remind folks to bring their tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates. If I hear anything secondhand, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep you posted on what still needs fixing, and I’ll remind folks to bring their tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Glad to help, Mara. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate it. It’s now Sunday at the community center, and if you can bring a small toolkit, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do that, Mara. I’ll bring a small toolkit to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and ready to help keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thank you—after school pickup should put me there a little after 9, and I’ll help unload and sort.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine, Faye. I’ll get there at 9 and we’ll take it step by step.
